panels.title: Primary / Replica State (per node)
panels.description: REAL, from Patroni's own /metrics. 1 = this node currently holds that role. A leader change (failover) shows as the 1 moving to a different node.

panels.title: Replication Lag (bytes, approx, from Patroni WAL position)
panels.description: REAL, computed from Patroni's own patroni_xlog_location (leader) and patroni_xlog_replayed_location (each node); zeroed on the leader row via patroni_replica since lag only applies to replicas. NOT the same as RPO - this is live WAL byte lag, not a recovery-point guarantee. See R14/RTO-RPO.md for the real RPO measurement methodology.

panels.title: WAL Replay Activity (per node)
panels.description: REAL. A flat line during an outage means that node stopped replaying WAL; a resumed upward slope shows real recovery.

panels.title: Active Connections (current leader, via HAProxy write port)
panels.description: REAL, from postgres_exporter (prometheus-community, same image as R4) scraping the real Postgres leader through HAProxy's write port.

panels.title: PostgreSQL Availability
panels.description: REAL. pg_up drops to 0 only if HAProxy cannot reach any writable leader - i.e. real, full write-unavailability, not a single node's local status.
